conclusion_zh: 30k质量跌落主要由冻结baseline每3000步执行的静态opacity reset与30k保存/评估重合引起。30k保存和评估的是真实reset后状态；动态分支未reset。TB已证明后续训练PSNR恢复，但尚未有reset后另一个完整49帧评估，不能宣称质量通过或替换30k真实指标。
proven: Frozen and baseline train.py have identical SHA256; relevant schedule is inherited baseline behavior.
Static reset executes outside the densification condition, so densify_until_iter=15000 does not stop opacity resets at 30000.
30000 % opacity_reset_interval(3000) == 0; the dynamic branch is excluded from reset.
Reset caps static sigmoid opacity at 0.01, replaces its nn.Parameter and zeros Adam exp_avg and exp_avg_sq.
The new opacity parameter has no gradient from the already completed backward pass; the subsequent optimizer step does not undo the cap in that iteration.
Paper-path model components are saved after reset/optimizer/SGCM and evaluated from the same current model, with continuation state and complete checkpoint event published after evaluation.
TB shows a sharp reset-boundary discontinuity and subsequent recovery; an earlier reset at 27000 exhibits the same pattern.
All49 existing PNG composite images have low30k CPU PSNR consistent with original float metrics; this is not merely a bad JSON metric or video display.

Independent CPU checkpoint audit confirms100% of2234298 static opacity values<=0.01000001, max0.009999998845; static Adam first/second moments are entirely zero, while dynamic opacity is not capped and retains nonzero moments.
inference: The static opacity reset explains the dominant full-frame drop and bright transparent backgrounds; preserved high dynamic-ROI PSNR is consistent with dynamic opacity not being reset.

Observed recovery supports a temporary scheduled reset disturbance rather than sustained optimizer divergence; this does not establish later full49 quality or rule out smaller unrelated quality limitations.

checkpoint_event.metric_semantics: PSNR* uses composite RGB on dynamic region. PSNR-S uses composite RGB on static region. PSNR-SR uses static-branch RGB on the same static region after deleting all dynamic Gaussians.
checkpoint_event.tensor_content_audit: Inspected shared CPU audit JSON only, without reloading tensors: outputs/drivingeditor_campaign/vgpu_1011/checkpoint_030000_cpu_validation.json

region.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of per-frame PSNR, later macro-average scenes equally.
region.perfect_error_policy: Zero-error frames have infinite mathematical PSNR; saved as null and counted separately, excluded from finite mean.
region.mask_protocol: Explicit binary actor masks, union optional separately predicted shadows; nearest-neighbor resize.
region.interpretation: PSNR* uses composite RGB on dynamic region. PSNR-S uses composite RGB on static region. PSNR-SR uses static-branch RGB on the same static region after deleting all dynamic Gaussians.
limitations: Paper masked-PSNR normalization is unspecified; both ROI and full-image zero-padded conventions are reported.
No deletion-hole quality is measured: historical unobstructed GT is required for Table V.
Inferred/prepared masks are not independent manually annotated ground truth.

protocol_semantics.snapshot: The30k checkpoint is a genuine complete continuation snapshot at an opacity-reset boundary, not a representative recovered reconstruction snapshot.
protocol_semantics.comparison: The10k/20k/30k/40k/50k schedule samples different reset phases; the30k node uniquely coincides with reset, so the curve cannot be interpreted as monotonic quality progress.
protocol_semantics.paper_claim: This audit proves frozen code behavior, not that the paper authors intended the same late reset or evaluation phase.

safe_followup: Preserve the actual30k four-component checkpoint,49-frame videos and original metrics; annotate that the node was captured immediately after static opacity reset.
Continue read-only monitoring of existing train scalars and the next scheduled40k/50k full49 evaluations; do not treat one sampled-camera PSNR as full49 evaluation.
Use the separate CPU checkpoint audit to cross-check static capped opacity and zero Adam moments; no model restore or GPU rerender is needed for this diagnosis.
Any future phase-matched evaluation or schedule change would require a separately specified experimental protocol and must not be substituted into this frozen baseline lineage.
limitations: Recovered30k+ measurements are per-training-camera float metrics, not a later complete49-frame reconstruction evaluation.
PNG PSNR is computed from uint8 quantized saved images and differs slightly from original float metrics.
Stdlib TFRecord/protobuf parser decoded framing and scalars but did not recompute CRC32C.
This audit does not certify novel-view quality, deletion-hole quality or complete paper reproduction.
